layout.body:
Effective Communication in the Modern Workplace
A one-day intensive workshop for managers and team leaders. Learn practical strategies for conducting productive meetings, providing constructive feedback, and resolving workplace conflicts. Experienced facilitators will guide participants through interactive exercises and real-world scenarios. Workshop includes comprehensive workbook and light refreshments.
Early bird registration (before April 1): $195. Regular price: $245.
Limited to 25 participants to ensure personalized attention.
Certificate of completion provided for continuing education requirements.

options.A: A job training program for new employees
options.B: A professional workshop on workplace communication

questions.analysis: What is this advertisement promoting? 原文依据：标题 Effective Communication in the Modern Workplace 正文A one-day intensive workshop for managers and team leaders. 现代职场中的有效沟通，面向经理和团队领导者的一天强化工作坊。 (A) 新员工职业培训项目 → 错误 (B) 关于职场沟通的专业研讨会 → 正确 (C) 管理认证课程 → 错误 (D) 冲突解决咨询服务 → 错误

questions.stem: What does someone gain by registering early?

options.C: Guaranteed seating in the front row
options.D: A one-on-one session with a facilitator

questions.analysis: What does someone gain by registering early? 原文依据：Early bird registration (before April 1): $195. Regular price: $245. 早鸟注册（4 月 1 日前）：195 美元。正常价格：245 美元。 (A) 费用降低 → 正确 (B) 特殊证书 → 错误 (C) 保证前排座位 → 错误 (D) 与培训师一对一课程 → 错误

questions.stem: Why is participation limited to 25 people?

options.A: To keep costs affordable for participants
options.C: To provide personalized attention to participants
options.D: To ensure everyone receives a workbook

questions.analysis: Why is participation limited to 25 people? 原文依据：Limited to 25 participants to ensure personalized attention. 人数限制为 25 人，以确保个性化指导。 (A) 为参与者保持费用可负担 → 错误 (B) 满足继续教育要求 → 错误 (C) 为参与者提供个性化指导 → 正确 (D) 确保每个人都能得到手册 → 错误
